basic_info.description: Experience refined city living at 288 Pacific Ave #3D in San Franciscos historic Jackson Square. This 1BD/1BA condo features 748 sq ft of open living space, wide-plank oak floors, a private balcony, and a chefs kitchen with Wolf appliances and quartzite countertops. The marble bathroom offers spa-like luxury, and in-unit laundry, central A/C, and Nest Thermostat add modern comfort. Enjoy 24-hour lobby service, rooftop terraces, and secure parking. All in a boutique LEED Gold-certified building by Handel Architects, steps from top dining, shopping, and the Bay.
